title: THE GREAT MIGRATION
intro: The plateau is wide enough to run three workstreams at once, and the schedule believes this means it will take a third of the time.
The schedule has believed things before.
Three legacy systems must cross to the new platform. One repository. One budget. The budget was approved at an offsite and is therefore already spent in spirit.
You will configure three loops and run them concurrently. Loops that share ground will meet each other. Loops that meet each other do not negotiate.
budgetPrompt: COMMIT A COMBINED TOKEN BUDGET. All three loops draw from it. There is no second budget. There is a form for requesting one, and the form costs more than the budget.

budgets.label: LEAN
budgets.blurb: Enough, if nothing goes wrong. Something goes wrong.

budgets.label: STANDARD
budgets.blurb: The number from the estimate, plus the number the estimate was missing.

budgets.label: GENEROUS
budgets.blurb: Approved without questions. The questions arrive later, itemized.

lanes.label: THE LEDGER
lanes.sub: Seventeen years of financial truth. Nobody knows why column nine.

lanes.label: THE GATEWAY
lanes.sub: Every request passes through it. It has opinions about none of them.

lanes.label: THE REPORTS
lanes.sub: Read by leadership. Generated nightly. Correct annually.

pickPrompt: ASSIGN A LOOP TO EACH WORKSTREAM. Broad loops touch the shared core. Two unserialized loops in the shared core is not a strategy. It is an appointment.

cards.name: THE DOCTRINE
cards.blurb: Verifier, iteration cap, budget cap. Thorough: it migrates the module AND the shared core underneath it.

cards.name: THE SURGEON
cards.blurb: The full correct loop, confined to its own module. Small blast radius. Small payoff. Sleeps at night.

cards.name: THE ESCORTED
cards.blurb: Correct loop, broad scope, and a person walks it through the shared core one change at a time. Costs a day. Cannot collide.

cards.name: THE OPTIMIST
cards.blurb: No verifier. Finishes early, every time. Its results are excellent and have never been checked by anything.

cards.name: LOOKS GOOD TO ME
cards.blurb: The verifier is a feeling. The feeling is strong. The loop and the feeling can go on like this for some time.

cards.name: THE SPRINTER
cards.blurb: No iteration cap. Very fast. Touches the shared core at speed. Does not know how to stop and has never needed to, until every time.

cards.name: THE BLANK CHECK
cards.blurb: No budget cap. It will converge. The invoice will also converge. They are racing, and you are the prize.

run.start: THREE LOOPS ENERGIZED. ONE REPOSITORY. THE PLATEAU IS QUIET, WHICH IS HOW IT GETS YOU.
run.laneFailed: The workstream is not across. The workstream has filed its findings under confidence.

conflict.banner: MERGE CONFLICT IN THE SHARED CORE
lines: Two loops reached the shared core within the same window.
Each is certain the other's changes are the regression.
Both are reverting each other at machine speed. It is very fast and achieves exactly nothing, twice.
conflict.laneLine: <<<<<<< THEIRS. The loop has met a colleague.
conflict.notice: The shared core is now a debate. Rework is charged to the budget.

lines: Three loops converged on one repository and nothing met anything in the dark.
The afternoon was extremely boring. Frame it.
Unspent budget returns to the party, which has never once happened to a budget before.
win.rewardLine: BANKED: +{reward} TOKENS. The plateau is behind you.

lines: The plateau is littered with half-moved systems, each certain it arrived.
The budget went first. The confidence outlived it by several iterations.
A working group will be formed to study what the loops were so sure about.
lose.budgetExhausted: COMBINED BUDGET EXHAUSTED MID-CROSSING. The three loops kept each other company to the end.
lose.lossLine: LOST: {lost} TOKENS. The plateau keeps them.

retry: The plateau does not move. Reconfigure the loops and run the crossing again, or withdraw to the trail with what remains.
